mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. This mechanism is active in low interest rate environments.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of low interest rate environment instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in federal funds rate and consumer price inflation signals aggressive monetary tightening amid persistent inflation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of interaction instances, or interaction effect not statistically significant (p>0.05) in rolling 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), the S&P 500 underperforms as the Federal Reserve accelerates tightening, leading to negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of high inflation regime instances, or average return not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly job growth signals robust economic expansion and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of strong labor market instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1300.0 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or average return in low housing start months not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts and industrial production signals broad economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of interaction instances, or interaction effect not statistically significant (p>0.05) in rolling 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing contraction regimes (INDPRO < 100), the S&P 500 underperforms as industrial output declines, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of manufacturing contraction regime instances, or average return not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).
